rows.name: Evidence kit
rows.adaptation: Versioned evidence and voice card, author edit decisions and gaps.
rows.acceptance: Client corrects a material fact and approved wording. The prior revision remains visible.

rows.name: Buyer/message brief
rows.adaptation: Buyer question/role grid and distinct fit, observed interaction, need and expressed-interest fields.
rows.acceptance: A like alone never changes need or buying-interest status.

rows.name: Profile studio
rows.adaptation: Profile draft supported by approved offer and proof.
rows.acceptance: Client can explain whom the headline helps and inspect the Featured example.

rows.name: Decision-to-post workbench
rows.adaptation: Source-linked idea queue, voice-aware caption and approval history.
rows.acceptance: Every proposed topic has a buyer question, source, author position and takeaway.

rows.name: Visual/story planner
rows.adaptation: Native branded visual, purposeful natural photographic context and accessible export.
rows.acceptance: Font/legibility/render checks and actual human visual review pass.

rows.name: Profile/landing review
rows.adaptation: Bounded initial audit, priorities and optional one-tool recommendation.
rows.acceptance: Findings link to observed examples. No guarantee of conversion lift.

rows.name: Search planner
rows.adaptation: Permitted native-search brief and optional verified enrichment route.
rows.acceptance: Domain, role and reason to contact are checked with sources.

rows.name: Research CSV workbench
rows.adaptation: Contact evidence ledger, deduplication and source/date fields.
rows.acceptance: Duplicate observations remain one person/contact with multiple dated events.

rows.name: Owned-media intake
rows.adaptation: Permitted author recordings/material, preserved original and reviewed notes.
rows.acceptance: Author approves the actual facts/voice, no invented personal story.

rows.name: Business email finder and verification brief
rows.adaptation: Existing proposed module, vendor/source/cost verification first.
rows.acceptance: Identity and permitted business-contact route verified before any sending.

rows.name: Outreach campaign and reply planner
rows.adaptation: Relevant reply/comment drafts, actual conversation stage and sales handoff brief.
rows.acceptance: A human sees context and approves an actual external action. Reply and next step are logged separately from reactions.

rows.name: LinkedIn ads strategy and measurement brief
rows.adaptation: Separate paid-distribution test and measurement brief.
rows.acceptance: Budget, payer, account permissions and measurement agreed. No new ads capability inferred from CCCrafts.

cross_cutting_candidate.name: Publora
cross_cutting_candidate.role: Approved publishing adapter and possibly owned-account reporting after tests
cross_cutting_candidate.scope_limit: Not a replacement for arbitrary LinkedIn feed research or the held collector
